caption:
About 1 in 4 maxillary sinuses contains at least one bony septum. In a CT analysis of 200 sinuses in 100 implant patients, 26.5% had one or more septa: 31.8% in atrophic edentulous segments and 22.6% in non-atrophic dentate segments. Septa matter because they complicate the lateral window and sinus membrane elevation.

Source: Kim MJ, Jung UW, Kim CS, et al. Maxillary sinus septa: prevalence, height, location, and morphology. A reformatted computed tomography scan analysis. J Periodontol. 2006;77(5):903-908. doi:10.1902/jop.2006.050247
